questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you to watch for pedestrians, especially children. Always yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Be alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a curve is ahead in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign appears with a traffic signal. It means drivers turning left on a green light do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down, then swings it down to their side, riders behind should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp curve. Slow down as much as you would at an intersection turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts drivers to an intersection coming up. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it is a hand signal that means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left. Riders use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for the train to pass before crossing the tracks.
